statement: Under Assumptions 5.2--5.5, fixed empirical measures on distinct points, and Algorithm 1 with gamma_t=2/(t+2), the lifted population-risk error is at most 32 alpha n_min/(T+3) plus C times the two W1 empirical-measure errors. For iid samples, n_X,n_Y tending to infinity and n_min/T_n tending to zero imply almost-sure risk consistency.

quantifiers.theorem_5_6: every alpha in [0,1], every iteration count T, and every fixed distinct empirical support satisfying the stated population assumptions
quantifiers.corollary_5_7: iid sequences with both sample sizes diverging and n_min/T_n tending to zero

acceptance_obligations: preserve Assumptions 5.2--5.5 and the distinct-support condition
execute Algorithm 1 with gamma_0=1 and gamma_t=2/(t+2)
reconstruct the E1+E2+E3 proof decomposition and explicit constant
derive almost-sure consistency without using finite trajectories as proof
independently recompute raw FW gaps and formula rows
reject the invalid T_n=n schedule for the intended reason
non_circularity: The analytical certificate carries the universal result. Numerical supports, seeds, checkpoints, and T_n=n^2 diagnostic schedule were declared before observation and are not selected to manufacture a target slope or tolerance.
